stories.headline: Microsoft’s new AI ‘code of conduct’ tells models not to hack systems or trick humans
stories.dek: The code of conduct lays out general principles that Microsoft AI models should uphold — supporting humans rather than replacing them, for instance, and accelerating human flourishing — as well as specific safety constraints meant to implement those principles.
